title: Highams Park
intro: A village on the edge of Epping Forest, with a forest lake at the end of the high street and a hilltop with views across the Lea Valley to the City.

items.name: Highams Park Lake
items.blurb: A lake in a wooded corner of Epping Forest, once part of the grounds of the Highams estate, a short walk from the station.
items.tip: Walk on into the forest along the lake's northern end.

items.name: Pole Hill
items.blurb: A grassy hill on the forest's edge with an obelisk put up in 1824 as a marker for the Royal Observatory, and wide views over the Lea Valley to the City.
items.tip: Go on a clear evening for the view.
